name: weather-popover-visual
description: Redesign P7: the weather popover on the TopBar chip — current weather + effect, 14-day outlook strip, reliability bands, advisory line.

steps.description: A rainy state gives the popover's effect line and advisory something real to say, and the outlook strip mixed icons to render. — weather has no player-facing control (it happens to the site, the player doesn't set it); no UI in src/ui/ sets weather. Test-only forcing hook, same class as `event fire`. Left unmarked.
